title: Uncovering the Missing Pattern: Unified Framework Towards Trajectory Imputation and Prediction
summary: A unified GC-VRNN framework for trajectory imputation and prediction that treats incomplete observations and their temporal missing patterns as first-class inputs.

mechanisms.name: Missingness-aware joint imputation and forecasting
mechanisms.description: Use a multi-space graph representation plus a temporal-decay conditional recurrent model to encode incomplete multi-agent observations, jointly impute bounded missing history, and predict future trajectories.
mechanisms.limitations: Benchmark imputation does not prove that a fully unseen target exists. An imputed point is not a sensor observation, identity authority, calibrated collision probability, or evidence of safety; unsupported gaps must remain UNKNOWN.
